results.title: War in Ukraine most likely to end with ceasefire, not peace – Dutch diplomat
results.description: Robert Serry, the first Ambassador of the Netherlands to Ukraine, serving from 1992 to 1996, said that Russia’s war against Ukraine will most likely end with a ceasefire rather than peace.

results.title: 'Constitute Welfare Board, Withdraw Hiked Fitness Fees': Delhi Auto Drivers To Stage Major Protest At Jantar Mantar Today
results.description: Delhi Auto Rickshaw Sangh will stage a protest at Jantar Mantar on Monday, demanding an immediate welfare board for auto-taxi drivers and withdrawal of increased vehicle fitness fees. The union, under Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh, also seeks working-time limits, accountability for transport officials and a ban on bike taxis using private number plates.
